name: Near cache holding address 0
description: COPY instructions addressed through a near cache slot whose cached address is 0
test_objectives: Verify the near cache is zero-filled at the start of a window (RFC 3284 section 5.1)
Verify address 0 is a usable near cache entry rather than an 'uninitialized' slot
Verify near modes 2 and 3 resolve to near[slot] + offset
